llm_response.reason: The website exhibits numerous scam signals: claims of SEC licensing and global headquarters with all company details redacted; extremely recent and privacy-protected domain registration inconsistent with global operations; excessive promises like zero fees, 100% guarantees, instant sign-up, and 'world-leading' status; lack of real contact information or valid support channels (only a personal email listed); absence of any real hyperlinks typical for legitimate exchanges; mismatched WHOIS country; ambiguous or misleading statements about legal compliance and licensing; and urgent calls to action. These align closely with the typical characteristics of cryptocurrency scam sites.
